candidates.sbom_dependency_posture: Release attestation/checksum evidence exists; a CrownThrive adoption SBOM and dependency/vulnerability scan remain required.
candidates.privacy_data_posture: Policy input/data handling must be constrained by the CrownThrive adapter contract; no private evidence body may be exported merely because the engine can process JSON/data.

candidates.exit_fork_strategy: Keep CrownThrive policy IDs/bundles portable and adapter-owned. Prefer upstream dependency/adapter; fork only for required governed divergence, unavailable security fix or continuity need, preserving history and notices.
candidates.upstream_contribution_strategy: Submit generic non-proprietary fixes upstream when practical; keep CHLOM-specific rules, private evidence and restricted IP in CrownThrive-controlled modules.
